title: Isolation of stromal vascular fraction from murine adipose tissue and beige adipocyte differentiation
author: Tang, Xu, et al.

steps.title: Prepare dissection tools and tubes
steps.instruction: Autoclave scissors and forceps, place 75 % ethanol for disinfection, and ready 50 mL and 15 mL Falcon tubes.

steps.title: Prepare reagents for cell isolation
steps.instruction: Place sterilized, pre‑cooled PBS and pre‑warmed DMEM on the bench; make digestion buffer by adding collagenase type I to DMEM to a final concentration of 1 mg/mL and filter through a 0.22 µm filter; prepare 6‑well plates for SVF seeding; prepare culture medium (DMEM + 10 % fetal bovine serum + 1 % penicillin/streptomycin). Store culture medium at 4 °C and pre‑warm before use; keep PBS at 4 °C.

steps.title: Harvest and mince adipose tissue
steps.instruction: Collect enough fat pads into a 2 mL Eppendorf tube, add cold PBS, and mince the tissue with scissors into pieces smaller than 1–2 mm³.

steps.title: Digest minced tissue
steps.instruction: Transfer the minced tissue to a 15 mL tube, add 6–8 mL warm digestion buffer, and incubate in a 37 °C water bath for 15–30 min, shaking vigorously by hand for 10 s every 5 min. Stop digestion when visible tissue fragments disappear and the mixture becomes homogeneous (turbid). An oscillating water bath may be used as an alternative.

steps.title: Quench digestion
steps.instruction: Add 2–3 mL culture medium to the tube to stop the enzymatic reaction.

steps.title: First filtration (100 µm)
steps.instruction: Filter the suspension through a 100 µm nylon mesh into a new 50 mL tube; rinse the original digestion tube with 10 mL PBS, filter the rinse through the same mesh, and combine the flow‑throughs.

steps.title: Second filtration (70 µm)
steps.instruction: Filter the combined suspension through a 70 µm nylon mesh into another 50 mL tube; rinse the original digestion tube with 10 mL PBS, filter the rinse through the same mesh, and combine the flow‑throughs.

steps.title: Centrifuge to pellet SVF cells
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the pooled filtrate at 1000 × g for 15 min at 4 °C.

steps.title: Remove fat layer and lyse red blood cells
steps.instruction: Carefully discard the visible fat layer, then discard the clear supernatant without disturbing the cell pellet. Add 3–5 mL red blood cell lysis buffer, let stand at 4 °C for 3–5 min, then add 10 mL culture medium to terminate lysis.

steps.title: Second centrifugation
steps.instruction: Centrifuge again at 1000 × g for 15 min at 4 °C and discard the supernatant.

steps.title: Resuspend SVF pellet
steps.instruction: Resuspend the cell pellet in 1 mL culture medium.

steps.title: Seed SVF cells for culture
steps.instruction: Plate the 1 mL cell suspension into each well of a 6‑well plate that already contains 1 mL pre‑warmed culture medium (total volume 2 mL per well) and incubate at 37 °C with 5 % CO₂.
